ai_summary: AGI Infra Limited successfully closed its Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) on November 18, 2026, securing capital by issuing equity shares to Qualified Institutional Buyers. The shares were priced at ₹265 each, representing a 1.56% discount to the floor price of ₹269.205, which will provide capital infusion for the company but also result in dilution for existing shareholders. While the document contained a minor formatting error in presenting the issue price, no material red flags or adverse impacts beyond standard dilution from such an offering are evident.
